Consider the matrix $B=\begin{bmatrix} 1 \amp 0 \\ 2 \amp -1 \\ 1 \amp 2 \end{bmatrix}$ and notice that $B=A^T$ where $A$ is the matrix in [ex-7-4-1].

Use your result from [ex-7-4-1] to find a singular value decomposition of $B=U\Sigma V^T$.

What is $\rank(B)$? Determine a basis for $\col(B)$ and $\col(B)^\perp$.

Suppose that $\bvec=\threevec{-3}47$. Use the bases you found in the previous part of this exercise to write $\bvec=\bhat+\bvec^\perp$, where $\bhat$ is in $\col(B)$ and $\bvec^\perp$ is in $\col(B)^\perp$.

Find the least-squares approximate solution to the equation $B\xvec=\bvec$.
